description: External works comprising alterations to front and rear elevations including new and replacement windows and doors, installation of new door at rear ground floor level with external metal staircase and 4no. French doors at rear basement level. Replacement of plastic downpipes and flue to rear with iron downpipes and replacement of metal railings to front lightwell staircase, installation of new paving to front lightwell and creation of new access hatch and automatic opening vent to roof, installation of rooftop plant and associated works. Internal works comprising reconfiguration and alteration, including installation of internal plant, in association with the proposed conversion of HMO accommodation and creation of 28no. (Class C3) studio flats. (MAJOR APPLICATION)
